verdict.rationale: Sardine's Case Management is described as a unified workspace to review alerts, investigate, and resolve cases, so the analyst can resolve alerts such as false positives. The claims about AI agents clearing false positives and being "audit-ready" describe automated agent behavior, not analyst override workflows. missing for 10: documented ability to reopen a resolved case, explicit override of a decision by an analyst, an audit record or history of analyst resolution and override actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
